title: 星展CEO谈AI时代：信任与数据护城河，如何保护客户信任？
speaker: Tan Su Shan

segments.en: Number three, trust. That money can't buy. But your customer trust in you is sacrosanct. And how do you protect that?
segments.zh: 第三是信任，金钱买不到。客户对你的信任是神圣不可侵犯的，你如何保护它？

segments.en: So for us, it's all about making sure our data works end to end. You need to have ownership end to end from the moment the data is born to the day is expelled, expelled from the system.
segments.zh: 对我们来说，关键是确保数据端到端运作。从数据诞生到从系统删除，你需要端到端的所有权。

segments.en: Who owns it? How do you keep it safe? And how do you use it in a way that it's spainable and useful to your customer?
segments.zh: 谁拥有它？如何保证安全？如何以可持续且对客户有用的方式使用它？

segments.en: And then your culture of innovation, your people, people that are telling me, you know, the level one production engineering work is gone.
segments.zh: 然后是创新文化和人才，有人告诉我，一级生产工程工作已经消失。

segments.en: So I'm now learning domain knowledge, whether it's wealth tag, trading tag, alcohol trading, whatever it is.
segments.zh: 所以我现在学习领域知识，无论是财富标签、交易标签还是其他。

segments.en: They're learning that domain knowledge and they're upscaling to become a level two builder, level two production engineer.
segments.zh: 他们学习领域知识，并升级为二级构建者、二级生产工程师。

segments.en: That means you become a higher productivity, higher order work. And that's what we're hoping that the AI won't enable the human to take on higher order work.
segments.zh: 这意味着你成为更高生产力、更高阶的工作。我们希望AI能让人类承担更高阶的工作。

segments.en: There will come a time where customers might have their own agents interact with your agents, right?
segments.zh: 未来客户可能会有自己的智能体与你的智能体互动。

segments.en: But if you're lucky and your agents are good and trusted customers might use your agent, right?
segments.zh: 如果幸运，你的智能体优秀且受信任，客户可能会使用你的智能体。

segments.en: So and then it's how you create your agent control plane, how you create your agent harness to be safe, to be relevant, and to have end-to-end accountability, to be grounded in governance and
segments.zh: 然后是如何创建智能体控制平面和工具，确保安全、相关、端到端问责，并以治理为基础。

segments.en: and to be grounded in governance and ...
